message.content: {"skills":[{"name":"允许域名正则构建","description":"在 spider_opened 阶段根据 spider 配置构建用于匹配允许域名的 host_regex 正则对象，供后续请求过滤逻辑复用。","prompt":"在 spider_opened 阶段调用 get_host_regex(spider) 构建 host_regex 正则对象并保存为实例属性，供后续 should_follow 等请求过滤逻辑复用。仅做规则初始化，不在此步骤过滤请求。","asset_type":"micro_skill","asset_node_id":"micro_skill_node","granularity":"micro","objective":"在spider_opened阶段构建host_regex","domain":"scrapy","task_family":"域名规则初始化","method_family":"正则表达式构建","stage":"spider_opened","applicable_signals":["spider启动时需要初始化域名匹配规则"],"intervention_moves":["在spider_opened中调用get_host_regex(spider)","将返回的正则对象保存为self.host_regex供后续复用"],"contraindications":["spider尚未打开或未配置允许域名"],"triggers":["spider启动时需要初始化域名匹配规则","需要在请求过滤前准备站内域名判定规则"],"workflow_steps":["在spider_opened(self, spider)中调用self.get_host_regex(spider)","将结果赋值给self.host_regex","后续请求过滤逻辑直接复用该正则对象"],"constraints":["仅在spider_opened阶段执行初始化","本步骤不执行请求过滤，只构建规则"],"cautions":["hostname可能为None（如javascript链接），匹配时需容错处理"],"output_contract":["生成可复用的host_regex正则对象"],"examples":[],"tags":["scrapy","offsite","域名规则","正则构建","spider_opened"],"confidence":0.8,"risk_class":"low","support_ids":["df27c7ab-e3e2-5b68-b833-647faad9c2a8"],"source_draft_ids":["69e66254-54bb-5dd6-b07c-da44b09cb5bd"]}]}
